title: 010 水母里有三个半人-《第19次末日》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “晏梨！”

    晏梨脚步一顿，循声回头朝着小楼门口看了过去。

    谢遂之跑了过来，他的胸膛微微起伏，脸上因为运动带了几分红晕，碎发有些凌乱的翘起。

    “红豆面包还有香蕉牛奶。”

    他说着，站在台阶上，将一个便利店的塑料袋递了过来。

    晏梨这才恍惚地觉得，经过一番战斗，她早就已经饥肠辘辘了，她没有客气的接了过来。

    谢遂之下了台阶，走到了晏梨面前，他身量很高，看人的时候要低垂着头。

    待他靠近了，晏梨还能闻到他身上淡淡的洗发水的味道，很清新像是某种刚发出嫩芽的草木。

    晏梨没有说话，撕开一个面包的包装袋，递给了谢遂之。

    然后直接在台阶上坐下，拿出另外一个来，团吧团吧三两下塞进了自己嘴中。

    她将牛奶拿出来，把塑料袋胡乱的铺在台阶上，冲着谢遂之指了指。

    谢遂之咬了一口面包，红豆其实有些甜腻，还带着上个世纪老式的味道，不过却是他童年甜蜜又痛苦的回忆。

    那时候他也与晏梨坐在青年路218号的楼梯上，分吃着这种老式面包。

    晏梨很野，她会靠着墙，突然扭出一个刷爆医保卡的奇怪动作。

    那是得把他五马分尸之后，然后再胡乱拼凑才能拼出来的样子。

    月光将她的影子照在墙上，像是一个扭曲的恶鬼，这于童年的他而言，是可以和爷爷的爆炸艺术相提并论的噩梦。

    他侧过脸，晏梨吃东西狼吞虎咽，面包将她的两腮挤得鼓鼓的，嘴角还有碎屑。

    “你不觉得今晚的月亮很奇怪么？像是一只眼睛。”

    谢遂之听着晏梨的话，抬头朝着天空看了过去。

    今晚的月亮像小时候一样明亮，将夜晚的路照得格外的清晰。

    月球表面的阴影也像是用水冲洗过了一般，圆形的坑洼，黑漆漆的枝丫纹路都看得一清二楚。

    明明不像眼睛，却给人一种注视笼罩着一切的诡异感。

    人看月亮看得久了，好似整个灵魂都要被吸进去。

    月亮活了。

    晏梨摊开了自己的右手掌心，之前她割开了手，将金属种子埋了进去，这会儿手上的伤口已经完全愈合，只留下了一个浅浅的疤痕。

    “我总感觉，这种子是活的，像是一个跳动的心脏。”

    她说着，并没有多解释什么，将香蕉牛奶一口吸光，然后把盒子捏瘪塞进面包包装袋里，轻轻一扔，精准的投进了花坛边的垃圾桶里。

Page (1/3)

"Yan Li!"

Yan Li paused and turned around to look at the door of the small building.

Xie Suizhi ran over, his chest heaving slightly, his face a little flushed from the exercise, and his broken hair was a little messy.

“Red bean bread and banana milk.”

He said, standing on the steps and handed over a plastic bag from the convenience store.

Yan Li suddenly felt that after a fight, she was already hungry, so she took it without politeness.

Xie Sui walked down the steps and walked up to Yan Li. He was very tall and had to lower his head when looking at people.

When he got closer, Yan Li could still smell the faint smell of shampoo on his body, which was very fresh, like some kind of grass that had just sprouted.

Yan Li didn't say anything, she tore open a bread bag and handed it to Xie Suizhi.

Then he sat down directly on the steps, took out another one, and stuffed it into his mouth three or two times.

She took out the milk, spread the plastic bags randomly on the steps, and pointed at Xie Suizhi.

Xie Suizhi took a bite of the bread. The red beans were actually a bit sweet and had an old-fashioned taste from the last century, but they were sweet and painful memories of his childhood.

At that time, he and Yan Li were sitting on the stairs of No. 218 Qingnian Road, sharing this old-fashioned bread.

Yan Li is very wild. She will lean against the wall and suddenly make a strange move that maxes out her medical insurance card.

“That’s what it looks like after you cut him into pieces and then piece them together randomly.

The moonlight cast her shadow on the wall, like a twisted evil ghost. For him as a child, this was a nightmare comparable to his grandfather's explosive art.

He turned his face sideways, and Yan Li was devouring the food. The bread bulged her cheeks, and there were crumbs in the corners of her mouth.

"Don't you think the moon tonight is strange? It looks like an eye."

Xie Suizhi listened to Yan Li's words and looked up at the sky.

The moon tonight is as bright as it was when I was a child, illuminating the road at night particularly clearly.

The shadows on the moon's surface also seemed to have been washed with water, and the circular pits and dark branches were clearly visible.

Although it doesn’t look like eyes, it gives people a strange feeling of being surrounded by everything.

When a person looks at the moon for a long time, it seems that his whole soul is being sucked in.

The moon is alive.

Yan Li opened the palm of her right hand. She cut her hand open before and buried the metal seeds in it. Now the wound on her hand has completely healed, leaving only a shallow scar.

“I always feel that this seed is alive, like a beating heart.”

She said, without explaining much, she sucked up all the banana milk in one gulp, then crushed the box and stuffed it into a bread bag, threw it gently, and accurately threw it into the trash can next to the flower bed.
